# RestoreEvidence

`schemas/records/restore-evidence.json`

The payload of lease.restore_recorded/v1 (docs/design/m0/05 "Evidence-target leases"): the outcome of one restore of a lease's evidence target, recorded when the restore runs, under the lease's subject. lease.restore_verified names a verified one by its receipt. internal/lease checks, from the log alone, that it is recorded while the lease restores, for the lease's attempt and one of the targets its grant recorded, under a receipt id not used before.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `receipt` | yes | [ReceiptID](common-defs.md#receiptid) | The restore's receipt, which lease.restore_verified names. |
| `lease` | yes | [LeaseID](common-defs.md#leaseid) |  |
| `attempt` | yes | [AttemptID](common-defs.md#attemptid) | The evidence run the restore follows. |
| `group` | yes | [ResourceGroupID](common-defs.md#resourcegroupid) | The evidence_target group restored. |
| `cycle` | yes | integer (minimum `1`, maximum `9007199254740991`) | The lease's restore cycle: 1 after its first lease.restore_started, one more after each. |
| `verified` | yes | boolean | Whether the restore was verified: the target is back as it was. |
| `detail` | yes | string (maxLength `4096`) | What the restore observed; non-empty when it was not verified. |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (1, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `verified` `false`, then `detail` any (minLength `1`)
